data.summary: The 'open-design' directory is a static design-reference bundle for the AIO Sandbox (沙箱) product, containing two standalone HTML screens: a model configuration screen and a workspace screen. Both pages share the same Cloudflare Kumo UI semantic token binding layer (embedded as inline CSS) adapted for the Open Design system, so they act as visual/UX specifications rather than executable application code. No build, framework, or backend logic lives here.

file_insights.name: screens_workspace.html
file_insights.summary: Standalone HTML mockup of the AIO Sandbox main workspace screen, styled with Cloudflare Kumo UI design tokens under a dark theme and Chinese (zh-CN) locale.
file_insights.source_summary: The document is an HTML5 skeleton with a zh-CN lang attribute, data-mode='dark', a viewport meta tag, and a title of 'AIO 沙箱 · 工作台'. Nearly all content is a <style> block documenting the provenance of the design tokens (kumo-ui.com colors, the Kumo GitHub commit, and theme-generator/config.ts) followed by the adapted token definitions and screen styling. There is no JavaScript or server-side logic present.
file_insights.detailed_description: This file is a self-contained HTML page representing the primary workspace ('工作台') of the AIO Sandbox product. It declares a dark-mode document root, embeds a large inline stylesheet that adapts Cloudflare Kumo UI color/token values into Open Design semantic bindings, and lays out the screen's UI regions. It functions as a design deliverable / prototype reference rather than production application logic.
responsibilities: Render the dark-themed AIO Sandbox workspace screen layout
Define and apply Cloudflare Kumo UI derived design tokens (colors, semantic bindings)
Serve as a visual/UX specification for the workspace view
Set locale, viewport, and document metadata for the screen

interfaces.name: Kumo semantic color tokens (inline CSS custom properties)

file_insights.name: screens_model-config.html
file_insights.summary: Standalone HTML mockup of the AIO Sandbox model configuration screen, reusing the same Cloudflare Kumo UI derived dark-theme token layer.
file_insights.source_summary: The source consists of an HTML5 document with charset/viewport metadata, the title 'AIO 沙箱 · 模型配置', and an inline <style> block whose comments cite the upstream Kumo UI color source, a specific Kumo GitHub commit hash, and the theme-generator config file from which token values were adapted. The style block then defines the semantic bindings and styling for the model configuration screen; no scripts are included.
file_insights.detailed_description: This file is a self-contained HTML page representing the model configuration ('模型配置') screen of the AIO Sandbox product. Like its sibling, it inlines a full Kumo-UI-derived stylesheet and presents the configuration form/settings UI in dark mode with a zh-CN locale. It is a static design artifact for the configuration workflow rather than runnable feature code.
responsibilities: Render the dark-themed AIO Sandbox model configuration screen
Reuse and apply the shared Kumo UI derived design token palette
Document the upstream token provenance for the configuration view
Define localization and document metadata for the screen
